seedcamp._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company rendered under different names across Seedcamp's surfaces (the 2026 live list, the 2008-2010 winners pages, the 2012-2017 /companies/ list, the 2017-2024 /our-startups/ JSON list, the Views posts) and its renames. Canonical = the live list's slug where the company is still listed. Written at kickoff (PRO-83, 2026-09-30) before the first prepare.

merges.name: Server Density
merges.reason: one company: Boxed Ice (Birmingham), a Seedcamp Week 2009 winner, renamed itself Server Density after its product; the 2009 winners page links boxedice.com under a logo, the live list carries Server Density with investment year 2009; the 2012-2013 /companies/ list also renders it 'Boxed Ice' (slug boxed-ice)

merges.name: Patients Know Best
merges.reason: one company: the 2009 winners page's logo pkb_200.png links patientsknowbest.com

merges.name: Wise
merges.reason: one company: TransferWise renamed itself Wise in February 2021; the 2013-2014 /companies/ list carries TransferWise, the live list Wise (investment year 2011)

merges.name: RentMineOnline
merges.reason: one company: the 2007 winners page's 'Rent Mine Online' (rentmineonline.com) and the live list's 'rentmineonline'; the firm's acquirer page renders it RentMineOnline

merges.name: CharlieHR
merges.reason: one company (charliehr.com): 'Charlie HR' on the live list, 'CharlieHR' on /our-startups/ 2018-2024 and in the company's own rendering

merges.name: Bloomsbury AI
merges.reason: one company (bloomsbury.ai): 'Bloomsbury' on the live list, 'Bloomsbury AI' on /our-startups/, the company's own name

merges.name: Fifth Dimension
merges.reason: one company (fifthdimensionai.com)

merges.name: Nodes & Links
merges.reason: one company (nodeslinks.com): 'Nodes and Links' on the live list, 'Nodes & Links' on /our-startups/ and the company's site

merges.name: StudentFinance
merges.reason: one company (studentfinance.com)

merges.name: Wefox
merges.reason: one company: wefox (wefox.com) traded as wefox Group 2019-2021 (wefoxgroup.com) and returned to wefox

merges.name: Zuko
merges.reason: one company: Formisimo (formisimo.com, on the 2013-2014 list) renamed itself Zuko; /our-startups/ 2021 lists Zuko with formisimo.com

merges.name: Wave
merges.reason: one company: TheWaveVR (thewavevr.com, the 2016-2017 list and the 2016-08-05 post 'Seedcamp joins $2.5m seed investment in TheWaveVR') renamed itself Wave (wavexr.com)

merges.name: EDITED
merges.reason: one company: EDITD (London, a Seedcamp Week 2010 winner) renamed itself EDITED (edited.com); the live list carries EDITED with investment year 2010

merges.name: Evercontact
merges.reason: one company: Kwaga (Paris, invested from Mini Seedcamp Paris 2009) launched Evercontact and took its name; the live list carries Evercontact with investment year 2009

merges.name: Fleksy
merges.reason: one company: ThingThing (Barcelona, the January 2016 cohort) acquired the Fleksy keyboard in 2016 and took the Fleksy name; the live list carries Fleksy with investment year 2015

merges.name: Orbital
merges.reason: one company: Orbital Witness (the 2019 investment, 'Orbital Witness raises GBP 1.2m', the firm's post) renamed itself Orbital (orbital.tech); the /our-startups/ list carries Orbital Witness, the live list Orbital

merges.name: Audiense
merges.reason: one company: SocialBro (Barcelona; Seedcamp Barcelona 2011, 'Welcome another brother!') renamed itself Audiense in 2016; the /our-startups/ list carries Audiense

merges.name: Apperio
merges.reason: one company: Legal Tender (London), a Seedcamp Week London 2013 team, renamed itself Apperio ('Apperio (previously Legal Tender) ... has rebranded as Apperio', the firm's November 2014 newsletter); the 2013-2014 /companies/ list carries Legal Tender, the 2018+ lists Apperio

merges.name: Flow AI
merges.reason: one company: Flowrite (Helsinki, the firm's Fund V pre-seed of 2020) sold its Flowrite product to Maestro Labs in Jan 2025 and continued as Flow AI; the live list carries Flow AI with investment year 2020 and Crunchbase's organization/flowrite is Flow AI

merges.name: HomeHero
merges.reason: one company: Homeshift (London, Seedcamp Week London 2014) renamed itself HomeHero; the firm's 2020-2024 lists carry HomeHero with the line 'Homeshift makes moving fun, convenient and stress free' under the 2014-09 logo

merges.name: Hitch
merges.reason: one company: API Changelog (London and Barcelona, September 2015 cohort) renamed itself Hitch ('Hitch (Spain) - Enables API providers to build connections with developers by detecting and communicating API changes', the firm's post of 2016-04-19); the firm's list carries Hitch under the 2015-09 logo

merges.name: Krak
merges.reason: one company: the 2014-03-12 /companies/ list names 'Krack (ex Wodd)'; the 2018+ lists carry Krak (skatekrak.com) under a 2014-04 logo; the firm's 2014 posts name Krak and its founder Kevin Straszburger

merges.name: LOOKK
merges.reason: one company: Garmz (Vienna, Seedcamp Week 2010 winner) renamed itself LOOKK ('LOOKK (Garmz)', the firm's post of 2011-09-08); the 2012-2014 /companies/ lists carry LOOKK

merges.name: Mava
merges.reason: one company: Koia (the firm's pre-seed of 2022-01-13) pivoted to Mava ('Goodbye, Koia ... hello Mava', co-founder Iris ten Teije); Crunchbase's organization/koia-5e28 is Mava

merges.name: Membrane
merges.reason: one company: Integration.app (the firm's Seed of 2023-11-07) renamed itself Membrane (getmembrane.com); integration.app's seed announcement now lives on getmembrane.com and Crunchbase's organization/integration-app is Membrane; the live list carries Membrane with investment year 2023

merges.name: Propoly
merges.reason: one company: Nanoget (UK, January 2016 cohort, 'Online rental management platform') renamed itself Propoly; the firm's 2018+ lists carry Propoly with the same line

merges.name: Milk.ly
merges.reason: one company: the firm's /companies/milk-ly/ page is titled Milkster from Aug 2014 (same site slug)

merges.name: Stupeflix
merges.reason: one company: the firm's 2017 list shows Stupeflix's card (site slug stupeflix) under its app's name, Replay

merges.name: Totems
merges.reason: one company: Teleportd (Paris, on the firm's 2012-2014 /companies/ lists; $1M for its Instagram tool Nitrogram, TNW 2012-11-26) became Nitrogram and then TOTEMS, which the firm lists from 2018 under a 2011-09 logo ('TOTEMS ... which we invested in back in 2011, and which was eventually acquired by Stripe in 2014', the firm's 2026 Dust post)

merges.name: Lua
merges.reason: one company: Whispr (the firm's pre-seed of 2019-03-14, 'the Irish/Danish startup') renamed itself Lua; the firm's lists carry both under the same line 'Voice-guidance and on-demand expertise for frontline workers', Whispr 2019-2020 and Lua 2020-2024 under a 2019-03 logo

merges.name: Simpo
merges.reason: one company: ActionBar (Tel Aviv, June 2016 cohort) renamed itself Simpo (founders Yuval Karmi and Yohanan Hruschev); the firm's list carries ActionBar 2017-2018 and Simpo 2018-2024 under the same 2016-06 logo

merges.name: Hack your Closet
merges.reason: one company: TPH (The Pasta Haters, Stockholm vintage marketplace, founder Lisa Gautier) became Hack your Closet; the firm's list carries TPH 2018-2019 and Hack your Closet 2019-2024 under the same 2018-04 logo

merges.name: BaseKit
merges.reason: one company: BaseKit's consumer builder SiteJam (Crunchbase's basekit-platform-ltd is titled Sitejam) held the BaseKit card on the firm's 2014 list, the one year BaseKit is missing from it

never_merge.reason: two companies on the live list: Flow (flowengineering.com, 2016) and Flow AI (flow-ai.com, 2020)
